objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document entity with properties, versions, and lifecycle states (creation, editing, release, archiving)

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Regulations and instructions for company-wide or business process-specific use

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed procedural steps and process sequences with responsible persons

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment subject to release cycle and versioning of main document

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary document information not subject to release cycle or versioning

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to document content managed independently of version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request for periodic review of document validity

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role with creation and modification rights on documents

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role responsible for technical and formal content verification

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for approving and publishing documents

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User with read-only access to approved documents

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach new document object with specified type and template

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Modify document content using office client and apply templates

evts.name: edit_metadata
evts.description: Maintain document properties and attributes

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document to PDF format after saving

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define group and person-level read and change permissions

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add controlled attachment to document

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Add supplementary information to document

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate 3-step release workflow starting with author signature

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal compliance

evts.name: approve_release
evts.description: Authorize document publication to readers

evts.name: sign_electronically
evts.description: Complete workflow task with electronic signature

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make released document visible to assigned readers

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate new editing version when modifying released document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark attachment as archived when no longer relevant

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose amendment to document without affecting current version

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create new version incorporating approved change proposal

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Update validity period for document upon successful review

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Request to invalidate and archive document

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Invalidate document and revoke user authorizations

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdraw document from circulation and revoke authorizations

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Remove archived document after archive duration expires

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Request re-validation of archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore archived document to valid state with new version

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send release notification to users in distribution list

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request users to actively confirm document acknowledgement

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User actively confirms receipt of document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create language-dependent version of released document

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated document content for accuracy

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish translated document version

o2o.description: Document contains controlled attachments with synchronized release cycles
Document contains supplementary information independent of release cycle
Change proposal references and belongs to specific document
Validity extension request is linked to document for periodic review
Override request references document to be invalidated
Reactivation request references previously archived document
Author creates and maintains document content
Reviewer checks document for technical and formal compliance
Releaser approves and authorizes document publication
Reader accesses approved documents via distribution assignment

o2e.description: Event produces PDF version of document
Event defines access permissions on document
Event creates attachment linked to document
Event makes document visible to readers
Event generates new version from modification
Event incorporates proposal into new version
